meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 当用户提供本地文档路径时，Claude 会先在本地将文档转成 Markdown 再读取回答，不上传文件。支持 Word、演示文稿、表格文件等；扫描版 PDF 会提示不支持。
howto.when: 当消息中带有本地附件路径且需要读取该文件时触发，转换默认在本地完成，不依赖外部解析器。

say.text: 把附件转成 Markdown 并总结要点
把附件里的 CSV 整理成 Markdown 表格
say.note: 会按 CSV 格式读取

say.text: 帮我把附件中的幻灯片转成 Markdown 大纲
say.note: 演示文稿会转为文本大纲

howto.what_en: Given a local path, Claude converts the document to Markdown locally, without uploading. Supports Word, presentations, and tabular files; scanned/image-only PDFs are reported as unsupported.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message provides a local attachment path that needs to be read; conversion happens locally without sending to an external parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attachment to Markdown and summarize the key points.
Turn the CSV attachment into a Markdown table.
Convert the slides in the attachment to a Markdown outline.
